tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: OnPress (온프레스) subscription plans for running a Korean internet newspaper: name, tagline, monthly price in KRW before VAT, first-year price where offered, and features. Answers in Korean.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search OnPress blog guides on starting and running a Korean internet newspaper (인터넷신문 창간, 등록, 보도자료, 포털 제휴, AI 편집국). Returns title, date, description, key points and URL. Without a query, the newest guides.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Key points and FAQ of one OnPress guide, by the slug or URL from search_guides, with the link to the full post.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: The newspaper site templates OnPress offers, each with a one-line description, a live demo paper and a signup link.

tools.name: how_to_start
tools.description: Steps to open a Korean internet newspaper with OnPress — sign up, name the paper, connect press-release sources, register and go public — with the signup, showroom and free check URLs. Use for "인터넷신문 어떻게 만들어?".

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_guides, get_guide, how_to_start · Public sink: get_guide.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_guides, get_guide, how_to_start · Public sink: get_guide

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
